sequence: Rituel — dénombrer et écrire les nombres jusqu'à 9
notes: Rituel projeté, 5 à 10 min, deux ateliers au choix dans les réglages. 1) Compter et écrire : une collection apparaît, chacun écrit le nombre sur son ardoise, le plus rapide écrit le chiffre au tableau au stylet puis touche le même chiffre à l'écran pour vérifier ; juste = une étoile. La révélation relie collection, chiffre tracé et autant de points rouges que d'unités. 2) La maison du nombre : chacun son tour prend des billes dans la boîte rouge et dans la boîte bleue, les pose sur la droite ; les doigts levés se colorent au fur et à mesure (3 doigts rouges + 6 bleus = 9) et une décomposition déjà trouvée est refusée. Les étoiles et les maisons sont conservées. Classe et période à ajuster : rituel filé sur l'année.

<title>Le rituel des nombres</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Lexend:wght@400;500;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout : trois bandes fixes — barre des medailles en haut, scene centrale plein cadre, frise des chiffres en pied. Un seul theme assume : papier d'ecole regle Seyes, encre bleue, et le rouge reserve aux points du chiffre. */
:root{
  --paper:#EDF2FB; --card:#FFFFFF; --ink:#16284F; --ink-soft:#5B6E92; --ink-faint:#9AABC8;
  --rule:#C8D9F1; --rule-soft:#E3EBF8;
  --red:#E0342A; --gold:#E9A51C;
  --rose:#DE4199; --rouge:#D22D2D; --vert:#17964C; --bleu:#2A68CC; --orange:#E2701A; --violet:#7B4CC4;
  --mA:#D92B2B; --mB:#2A68CC;
  --font-display:'Fredoka','Trebuchet MS',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-ui:'Lexend',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --r:20px;
  --lift:0 2px 0 rgba(22,40,79,.07), 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(22,40,79,.45);
  color-scheme:light;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
[hidden]{display:none !important}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0; font-family:var(--font-ui); color:var(--ink);
  background-color:var(--paper);
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(42,104,204,.10) 0 1px, transparent 1px 100%),
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(42,104,204,.055) 0 1px, transparent 1px 100%);
  background-size:100% 32px, 32px 100%;
  overflow:hidden;
}
button{font:inherit; color:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:0; background:none}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--bleu); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:6px}

#app{height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:0 clamp(12px,2vw,26px); gap:clamp(6px,1vh,14px)}

/* ---------- barre du haut ---------- */
.bar{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:clamp(8px,1.4vw,18px); padding-top:clamp(8px,1.4vh,16px); flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1}
.brand b{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(17px,2.1vw,25px); letter-spacing:.2px}
.brand span{font-size:clamp(10px,1vw,12.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; margin-top:3px}
.chips{display:flex; gap:clamp(6px,1vw,12px); margin-left:auto; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:flex-end; max-width:100%; min-width:0}
.chip{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:var(--card); border-radius:999px;
  padding:7px 16px 7px 8px; box-shadow:var(--lift); border:2px solid transparent}
.chip .pastille{width:clamp(26px,2.6vw,34px); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); display:grid; place-items:center;
  color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(13px,1.4vw,17px)}
.chip .who{font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(13px,1.4vw,17px); color:var(--c)}
.chip .tally{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:clamp(12px,1.3vw,16px)}
.chip .tally svg{width:1.1em; height:1.1em}
.chip.bump{animation:bump .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
@keyframes bump{40%{transform:scale(1.14) rotate(-2deg)}}
.classbar{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:clamp(11px,1.1vw,13px); color:var(--ink-soft)}
.classbar .track{width:clamp(60px,9vw,130px); height:9px; border-radius:99px; background:var(--rule-soft); overflow:hidden}
.classbar .fill{height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),#F7C94B); border-radius:99px; transition:width .5s ease}
.gear{background:var(--card); box-shadow:var(--lift); border-radius:999px; padding:9px 15px; font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,14.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px}
.gear:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* ---------- scene ---------- */
.stage{flex:1; min-height:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:clamp(6px,1.2vh,16px); position:relative}
.prompt{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; text-align:center; text-wrap:balance;
  font-size:clamp(21px,3.2vw,46px); line-height:1.1; min-height:1.2em}
.prompt em{font-style:normal; color:var(--bleu)}
.sub{font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,17.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); text-align:center; margin-top:-4px}

.boxwrap{flex:1; min-height:0; width:100%; display:grid; place-items:center}
.box{position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; max-height:100%; max-width:100%; margin-inline:auto;
  background:var(--card); border-radius:26px; box-shadow:var(--lift); overflow:hidden; border:3px solid #fff}
.box::after{content:''; position:absolute; inset:10px; border:2px dashed var(--rule-soft); border-radius:18px; pointer-events:none}
.field{position:absolute; inset:0}
.item{position:absolute; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0); transform-origin:center;
  display:grid; place-items:center; line-height:1}
.item.in{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1); animation:pop .42s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.4,1)}
@keyframes pop{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0) rotate(-14deg)}70%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.18) rotate(4deg)}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1) rotate(0)}}
.item .glyph{font-size:var(--sz); filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(22,40,79,.16))}
.item .pip{width:var(--sz); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.45), transparent 58%), var(--pc);
  box-shadow:0 6px 12px -7px rgba(22,40,79,.6)}
.item .num{position:absolute; top:-14%; right:-14%; min-width:1.75em; height:1.75em; padding:0 .3em; border-radius:999px;
  background:var(--ink); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:calc(var(--sz)*.42);
  display:grid; place-items:center; opacity:0; transform:scale(.4); transition:opacity .2s, transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
.item.counted .num{opacity:1; transform:scale(1)}
.item.counted{animation:tick .45s ease}
@keyframes tick{50%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.16)}}
.pack{position:absolute; border:3px dashed var(--rule); border-radius:22px; background:#F7FAFF}
.hands{position:absolute; inset:6% 4%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:3%}
.hands svg{height:100%; width:auto; max-width:46%}

.cover{position:absolute; inset:0; background:
   repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #2A68CC 0 26px, #2F72DB 26px 52px);
  display:grid; place-items:center; color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600;
  font-size:clamp(34px,10vmin,110px); transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); z-index:3}
.cover span{display:block; animation:breathe 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes breathe{50%{transform:scale(1.14)}}
.box.open .cover{transform:translateY(-101%)}

/* ---------- cartes eleves ---------- */
.picks{display:flex; gap:clamp(8px,1.6vw,20px); flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; width:100%}
.pick{min-width:0; background:var(--card); border-radius:999px; box-shadow:var(--lift); border:3px solid var(--c);
  padding:clamp(5px,.8vh,9px) clamp(14px,1.7vw,24px) clamp(5px,.8vh,9px) clamp(5px,.6vw,8px);
  display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:clamp(8px,1vw,14px);
  transition:transform .14s ease, box-shadow .14s ease}
.pick:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.pick .av{width:clamp(36px,4.2vw,62px); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); color:#fff;
  display:grid; place-items:center; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(17px,2.2vw,30px)}
.pick .nm{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; color:var(--c); font-size:clamp(18px,2.4vw,34px)}
.pick .hint{font-size:clamp(9px,.95vw,12.5px); color:var(--ink-faint); border:2px solid var(--rule-soft);
  border-radius:8px; padding:0 6px; font-weight:700}

/* ---------- tableau : nom + clavier ---------- */
.boardname{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; color:var(--c); font-size:clamp(34px,8vw,92px); line-height:1; text-align:center}
.keypad{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); gap:clamp(6px,1vw,12px); width:100%; max-width:760px}
.key{background:var(--card); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:var(--lift); padding:clamp(6px,1.2vh,12px) 0;
  display:grid; place-items:center; transition:transform .1s ease}
.key:active{transform:scale(.94)}
.key svg{width:clamp(28px,4.4vw,62px); height:auto}
.key.no{font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:clamp(11px,1.5vmin,15px); grid-column:span 1}
.key.no b{display:block; font-size:clamp(18px,3vmin,28px); color:var(--rouge)}

/* ---------- medaille ---------- */
.medal{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:clamp(4px,1vh,12px)}
.medal svg{width:clamp(130px,30vmin,300px); height:auto; animation:drop .9s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.5,1)}
@keyframes drop{0%{transform:translateY(-60%) rotate(-18deg); opacity:0}60%{transform:translateY(6%) rotate(6deg)}100%{transform:none; opacity:1}}
.medal .say{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,58px); color:var(--c)}
.confetti{position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; overflow:hidden; z-index:5}
.conf{position:absolute; width:12px; height:16px; border-radius:3px; animation:fall linear forwards}
@keyframes fall{0%{transform:translateY(-10vh) rotate(0); opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(720deg); opacity:.9}}

/* ---------- revelation ---------- */
.reveal{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:clamp(8px,1.6vw,20px); width:100%; align-items:stretch}
.rcard{background:var(--card); border-radius:var(--r); box-shadow:var(--lift); padding:clamp(8px,1.4vh,16px);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-width:0}
.rcard h3{margin:0; font-size:clamp(10px,1.3vmin,13px); letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:700}
.rcard .holder{flex:1; min-height:0; width:100%; display:grid; place-items:center}
.minibox{position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:14px; background:#F7FAFF; overflow:hidden; border:2px solid var(--rule-soft)}
.glyphsvg{width:100%; height:100%; max-height:min(34vh,330px)}
.trace{fill:none; stroke:var(--ink); stroke-width:11; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.ghost{fill:none; stroke:var(--rule-soft); stroke-width:11; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}
.secret .trace{stroke:var(--rule-soft)}
.pt{fill:var(--red); opacity:0; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center; transform:scale(.2)}
.pt.on{opacity:1; transform:scale(1); animation:ptin .34s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
@keyframes ptin{to{opacity:1; transform:scale(1)}}
.ptnum{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:17px; fill:var(--red); opacity:0}
.ptnum.on{opacity:1; transition:opacity .2s}
.tally-big{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,38px); color:var(--red); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.verdict{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; text-align:center; font-size:clamp(17px,2.4vw,34px)}
.verdict b{color:var(--red)}

/* ---------- pied : frise + action ---------- */
.foot{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:clamp(8px,1.5vw,18px); padding-bottom:calc(clamp(8px,1.4vh,16px) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); flex-wrap:wrap}
.frise{display:flex; gap:clamp(4px,.7vw,9px); flex:1; min-width:0}
.fcell{flex:1; min-width:0; background:var(--card); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(22,40,79,.07);
  padding:clamp(4px,.8vh,9px) 2px 3px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:2px; opacity:.42; transition:opacity .2s, transform .14s}
.fcell.on{opacity:1; box-shadow:var(--lift)}
.fcell:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.fcell svg{width:100%; max-width:46px; height:auto}
.fcell .w{font-size:clamp(8px,.95vw,11.5px); color:var(--ink-soft); font-weight:600}
.fcell.target{outline:3px solid var(--bleu); outline-offset:2px}
.actions{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center}
.btn{background:var(--ink); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; padding:clamp(10px,1.7vh,16px) clamp(18px,2.6vw,34px);
  font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(14px,1.9vmin,22px); box-shadow:var(--lift); transition:transform .12s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.btn.go{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2F74DF,#2358B4)}
.btn.ghost{background:var(--card); color:var(--ink-soft); font-family:var(--font-ui); font-weight:600; font-size:clamp(11.5px,1.4vmin,14px); padding:10px 16px}

/* ---------- panneau maitresse ---------- */
.panel{position:fixed; top:0; right:0; height:100%; width:min(430px,100%); background:var(--card); box-shadow:-20px 0 50px -30px rgba(22,40,79,.6);
  z-index:40; overflow-y:auto; padding:calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)) 18px calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px}
.panel h2{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; margin:0; font-size:21px}
.panel section{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px}
.panel h4{margin:0; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint)}
.row{display:flex; gap:7px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center}
.tog{border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:12px; min-width:40px; padding:8px 4px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:17px; color:var(--ink-soft); background:#fff; flex:1}
.tog.on{background:var(--bleu); border-color:var(--bleu); color:#fff}
.mini{border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:999px; padding:6px 12px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.mini.on{background:var(--ink); border-color:var(--ink); color:#fff}
.studrow{display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center}
.studrow input[type=text]{flex:1; min-width:0; border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:12px; padding:9px 11px; font:inherit; font-weight:600; background:#fff; color:var(--ink)}
.swatches{display:flex; gap:4px}
.sw{width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); border:3px solid #fff; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--rule-soft)}
.sw.on{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--ink)}
.kill{color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:19px; padding:0 4px}
.lab{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink)}
.lab input{width:19px; height:19px; accent-color:var(--bleu)}
select{border:2px solid var(--rule); border-radius:12px; padding:9px 11px; font:inherit; font-weight:600; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); width:100%}
.note{font-size:12.5px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink-soft)}
.note b{color:var(--ink)}
.note kbd{background:var(--rule-soft); border-radius:5px; padding:1px 6px; font-family:var(--font-ui); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink)}
.danger{color:var(--rouge); border:2px solid #F3C9C7; border-radius:12px; padding:9px 13px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; background:#FFF6F6}
.scrim{position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(22,40,79,.34); z-index:35}
.toast{position:fixed; left:50%; top:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)); transform:translateX(-50%); z-index:50;
  background:var(--ink); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; padding:11px 22px; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; box-shadow:var(--lift);
  animation:toastin .3s ease}
@keyframes toastin{from{opacity:0; transform:translate(-50%,-14px)}}

/* ---------- l'etoile et sa fete ---------- */
.medal{position:relative}
.medal > *{position:relative}
.rays{position:absolute; top:46%; left:50%; width:min(150vmin,1400px); aspect-ratio:1;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%); animation:spin 26s linear infinite; pointer-events:none}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg)}}
.bigstar{width:clamp(120px,26vmin,280px); height:auto; animation:starpop .85s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.5,1)}
@keyframes starpop{0%{transform:scale(.2) rotate(-35deg); opacity:0}60%{transform:scale(1.15) rotate(8deg)}100%{transform:none; opacity:1}}
@keyframes popin{0%{transform:scale(0)}70%{transform:scale(1.16)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.starrow{display:flex; gap:clamp(3px,.5vw,7px); flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; max-width:min(90%,760px)}
.starrow i{display:block; width:clamp(17px,2.2vw,32px); animation:popin .4s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1) backwards}
.starrow i svg{display:block; width:100%; height:auto}
.starrow b{font-weight:700; color:var(--gold); font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,19px); align-self:center}

/* ---------- la maison du nombre ---------- */
#view-deco{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:clamp(6px,1.4vh,16px); width:100%; flex:1; min-height:0; justify-content:center}
.deco-turn{display:flex; gap:clamp(6px,1vw,12px); justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap}
.tpill{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:999px; border:3px solid var(--c); background:#fff;
  padding:3px 14px 3px 4px; opacity:.38; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; color:var(--c);
  font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,21px); transition:opacity .2s}
.tpill.now{opacity:1; box-shadow:var(--lift)}
.tpill .av{width:clamp(24px,2.5vw,36px); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; background:var(--c); color:#fff;
  display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:.78em}
.deco-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:clamp(8px,1.6vw,24px); align-items:center; width:100%}
.bins{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:clamp(6px,1vh,12px)}
.bin{background:var(--card); border-radius:22px; box-shadow:var(--lift); border:3px solid var(--m);
  padding:clamp(6px,1vh,12px) clamp(8px,1vw,16px); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:5px;
  min-width:clamp(92px,10vw,146px); transition:transform .1s}
.bin:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.bin.empty{opacity:.35}
.binpile{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:clamp(3px,.4vw,6px); justify-items:center; min-height:clamp(26px,4vh,46px); align-content:center}
.binpile i{width:clamp(12px,1.4vw,21px); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.5), transparent 58%), var(--m)}
.binlab{font-size:clamp(9px,.95vw,12.5px); font-weight:700; color:var(--m); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.07em}
.lanewrap{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:clamp(5px,1.1vh,13px); min-width:0}
.lane{display:flex; gap:clamp(4px,.8vw,12px); align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; max-width:100%;
  background:#fff; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:var(--lift); padding:clamp(7px,1.2vh,14px) clamp(11px,1.5vw,22px)}
.slot{width:clamp(26px,3.8vw,60px); aspect-ratio:1; border-radius:50%; border:3px dashed var(--rule); padding:0; background:none}
.slot.full{border-color:transparent; border-style:solid}
.slot .bille{display:block; width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.5), transparent 58%), var(--m);
  box-shadow:0 7px 13px -8px rgba(22,40,79,.8); animation:popin .32s cubic-bezier(.2,1.6,.4,1)}
.lane.nope{animation:shake .45s}
@keyframes shake{20%{transform:translateX(-12px)}45%{transform:translateX(12px)}70%{transform:translateX(-6px)}}
.eq{font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(20px,3.2vw,50px); display:flex; gap:.22em; align-items:baseline; color:var(--ink)}
.eq .tot{color:var(--ink-faint)}
.eq .tot.ok{color:var(--ink)}
.handz{display:flex; gap:clamp(2px,.4vw,8px); align-items:flex-end; height:clamp(92px,23vh,268px)}

const LEVELS = [
  {name:"Constellations",        hint:"les points rangés comme sur le dé",        kinds:["pips"],                              flash:false},

/* ---------------- sons et voix ---------------- */
let AC = null;
function ac(){ if(!AC){ try{ AC = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); }catch(e){ AC = false; } } return AC || null; }
function tone(freq, dur, type, vol){
  if(!S.sound) return; const c = ac(); if(!c) return;
  try{
    const o = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain();
    o.type = type || "sine"; o.frequency.value = freq;
    g.gain.value = 0; o.connect(g); g.connect(c.destination);
    const t = c.currentTime;
    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol || 0.18, t + 0.015);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + (dur || 0.2));
    o.start(t); o.stop(t + (dur || 0.2) + 0.03);
  }catch(e){}
}

/* ---------------- svg des chiffres ---------------- */
function digitSVG(d, extra){
  const g = DIGITS[d]; if(!g) return "";
  const ghost = g.p.map(p => '<path class="ghost" d="'+p+'"/>').join("");
  const trace = g.p.map(p => '<path class="trace" d="'+p+'"/>').join("");
  return '<svg class="glyphsvg '+(extra||"")+'" viewBox="-6 -4 112 118" aria-label="chiffre '+d+'">'+ghost+trace+'</svg>';
}
function traceIn(svg, ms){
  svg.querySelectorAll(".trace").forEach((p, i) => {
    const L = p.getTotalLength();
    p.style.strokeDasharray = L; p.style.strokeDashoffset = L;
    p.style.transition = "stroke-dashoffset " + (ms||900) + "ms ease " + (i*(ms||900)*0.55) + "ms";
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { p.style.strokeDashoffset = 0; });
  });
}
function dotsAlong(svg, n){
  const paths = Array.from(svg.querySelectorAll(".trace"));
  const lens = paths.map(p => p.getTotalLength());
  const total = lens.reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0);
  const out = [];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    let t = ((i + 0.5) / n) * total, k = 0;
    while(k < lens.length - 1 && t > lens[k]){ t -= lens[k]; k++; }
    const pt = paths[k].getPointAtLength(Math.min(t, lens[k]));
    out.push(pt);
  }
  return out;
}

/* ---------------- fabrique de la collection ---------------- */
const CELLS = {x:[25,50,75], y:[26,50,74]};
const PIPPAT = {
  1:[[1,1]], 2:[[0,0],[2,2]], 3:[[0,0],[1,1],[2,2]], 4:[[0,0],[2,0],[0,2],[2,2]],
  5:[[0,0],[2,0],[1,1],[0,2],[2,2]], 6:[[0,0],[0,1],[0,2],[2,0],[2,1],[2,2]],
  7:[[0,0],[0,1],[0,2],[1,1],[2,0],[2,1],[2,2]],
  8:[[0,0],[0,1],[0,2],[1,0],[1,2],[2,0],[2,1],[2,2]],
  9:[[0,0],[0,1],[0,2],[1,0],[1,1],[1,2],[2,0],[2,1],[2,2]]
};
const rnd = (a,b) => a + Math.random()*(b-a);
const pick = a => a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)];

function posPips(n, box){
  const b = box || {x0:8,x1:92,y0:10,y1:90};
  return (PIPPAT[n]||PIPPAT[9]).map(([c,r]) => ({
    x: b.x0 + (CELLS.x[c]/100)*(b.x1-b.x0),
    y: b.y0 + (CELLS.y[r]/100)*(b.y1-b.y0)
  }));
}
function posLigne(n){
  if(n <= 5) return Array.from({length:n}, (_,i) => ({x: 50 + (i - (n-1)/2) * (68/Math.max(n,2)), y:50}));
  const top = Math.ceil(n/2), bot = n - top, out = [];
  for(let i=0;i<top;i++) out.push({x: 50 + (i - (top-1)/2) * (66/top), y:33});
  for(let i=0;i<bot;i++) out.push({x: 50 + (i - (bot-1)/2) * (66/top), y:67});
  return out;
}
function posDisperse(n){
  const out = [];
  let min = n > 6 ? 19 : 24;
  for(let guard=0; guard<400 && out.length<n; guard++){
    const p = {x: rnd(14,86), y: rnd(20,80)};
    if(out.every(q => Math.hypot(q.x-p.x, (q.y-p.y)*0.62) > min)) out.push(p);
    if(guard % 90 === 89) min *= 0.84;
  }
  while(out.length < n) out.push({x: rnd(16,84), y: rnd(22,78)});
  return out;
}
function handSVG(up){
  const fingers = [
    {x:26, h:58}, {x:42, h:66}, {x:58, h:60}, {x:74, h:48}
  ];
  let s = '<svg viewBox="0 0 108 152" aria-hidden="true">';
  s += '<g fill="#FFD9B8" stroke="#DFA87A" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round">';
  const thumbUp = up >= 1;
  s += thumbUp
    ? '<rect x="-2" y="58" width="22" height="52" rx="11" transform="rotate(-32 9 110)"/>'
    : '<rect x="12" y="92" width="46" height="21" rx="10"/>';
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const f = fingers[i], raised = up >= i + 2;
    const h = raised ? f.h : 24, y = 92 - h;
    s += '<rect x="'+f.x+'" y="'+y+'" width="15" height="'+(h+14)+'" rx="7.5"/>';
  }
  s += '<rect x="18" y="80" width="72" height="62" rx="22"/>';
  s += '</g></svg>';
  return s;
}

function buildRound(){
  const lvl = LEVELS[S.level] || LEVELS[0];
  const pool = S.digits.length ? S.digits.slice() : [1];
  let n = pick(pool);
  if(pool.length > 1 && n === lastN) n = pick(pool.filter(x => x !== lastN));
  lastN = n;
  let kinds = lvl.kinds.slice();
  if(n < 2) kinds = kinds.filter(k => k !== "paquets");
  if(n > 10) kinds = kinds.filter(k => k !== "doigts");
  if(!kinds.length) kinds = ["pips"];
  const kind = pick(kinds);
  const flash = lvl.flash === true || (lvl.flashChance ? Math.random() < lvl.flashChance : false);
  const icon = pick(ICONS), pc = pick(PIPC);
  let split = null;
  if(kind === "paquets"){ const a = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*(n-1)); split = [a, n-a]; }
  return {n, kind, flash, icon, pc, split, tries:[]};
}

function paintField(R){
  const f = $("#field"); f.innerHTML = "";
  const sz = R.n <= 3 ? 30 : (R.n <= 6 ? 24 : 19);

    el.innerHTML = (R.kind === "pips" || R.kind === "paquets")
      ? '<div class="pip"></div><div class="num">'+(i+1)+'</div>'
      : '<div class="glyph">'+R.icon+'</div><div class="num">'+(i+1)+'</div>';
    (inside || f).appendChild(el);

  };
  let items = [];

    h.innerHTML = handSVG(Math.min(R.n,5)) + (R.n > 5 ? '<div style="transform:scaleX(-1);height:100%">'+handSVG(R.n-5)+'</div>' : "");
    f.appendChild(h);

  if(R.kind === "paquets"){

function handSVGC(cols, mirror){
  const F = [{x:28,h:64},{x:46,h:74},{x:64,h:66},{x:82,h:52}], SKIN = "#FFD9B8";
  let s = '<svg viewBox="-28 -4 138 156" aria-hidden="true"' + (mirror ? ' style="transform:scaleX(-1)"' : '') + '>';

    : '<rect x="6" y="96" width="50" height="22" rx="11" fill="'+SKIN+'"/>';

    const f = F[i], c = cols[i+1], h = c ? f.h : 26;

function handsFor(a, b){

  const h1 = cols.slice(0,5), h2 = cols.slice(5,10);
  while(h1.length < 5) h1.push(null);
  while(h2.length < 5) h2.push(null);

  if(a + b > 5) out += handSVGC(h2, true);

  const mini = document.createElement("div"); mini.className = "minibox";
  const clone = $("#field").cloneNode(true);
  clone.querySelectorAll(".item").forEach(el => { el.classList.add("in","counted"); });
  mini.appendChild(clone); col.appendChild(mini); watchU(mini);

  $("#r-digit").innerHTML = digitSVG(R.n);
  traceIn($("#r-digit").querySelector("svg"), 1000);

  $("#r-secret").innerHTML = digitSVG(R.n, "secret");
  $("#r-count").innerHTML = " ";
  const svg = $("#r-secret").querySelector("svg");
  $("#verdict").innerHTML = R.n + " objets  →  j'écris <em>" + R.n + "</em>  →  <b>" + R.n + " points</b>. C'est bien " + WORDS[R.n] + " !";
  const f = $("#frise .fcell[data-d='" + R.n + "']");
  document.querySelectorAll(".fcell.target").forEach(e => e.classList.remove("target"));
  if(f) f.classList.add("target");

  later(() => {
    const pts = dotsAlong(svg, R.n);
    pts.forEach((p, i) => {
      const c = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
      c.setAttribute("cx", p.x); c.setAttribute("cy", p.y); c.setAttribute("r", 8.5);
      c.setAttribute("class", "pt"); c.dataset.i = i;
      svg.appendChild(c);
    });
    pts.forEach((p, i) => later(() => {
      const c = svg.querySelector('.pt[data-i="'+i+'"]'); if(c) c.classList.add("on");
      $("#r-count").textContent = Array.from({length:i+1}, (_,k) => k+1).join(" · ");
      tone(500 + i*60, 0.18, "triangle", 0.14); speak(WORDS[i+1]);
    }, 620 + i*680));
    later(() => {
      $("#r-count").textContent = "→ " + R.n + " points, " + WORDS[R.n] + " !";
      speak("Le " + WORDS[R.n] + " cache " + WORDS[R.n] + " points. C'est bien " + WORDS[R.n] + ".");
      tone(880, 0.3, "triangle", 0.15);
    }, 620 + R.n*680 + 250);
  }, 1150);
}

/* ---------------- panneau de la maitresse ---------------- */
function renderPanel(){
  const dt = $("#digit-togs"); dt.innerHTML = "";
  for(let d=1; d<=9; d++){
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "tog" + (S.digits.indexOf(d) >= 0 ? " on" : "");
    b.textContent = d;
    b.onclick = () => {
      const i = S.digits.indexOf(d);
      if(i >= 0) S.digits.splice(i,1); else S.digits.push(d);
      S.digits.sort((a,b2) => a-b2);
      if(!S.digits.length) S.digits = [d];
      save(); renderPanel(); renderFrise();
    };
    dt.appendChild(b);
  }
  const sel = $("#level-sel"); sel.innerHTML = "";
  LEVELS.forEach((l, i) => {
    const o = document.createElement("option");
    o.value = i; o.textContent = "Étape " + (i+1) + " — " + l.name + " (" + l.hint + ")";
    sel.appendChild(o);
  });
  sel.value = S.level;
  sel.onchange = () => { S.level = +sel.value; S.streak = 0; save(); renderChips(); };
  $("#auto-level").checked = !!S.autoLevel;
  $("#mode-sel").value = S.mode || "compter";
  $("#opt-both").checked = !!S.decoBoth;
  $("#opt-voice").checked = !!S.voice;
  $("#opt-sound").checked = !!S.sound;
  $("#opt-secret").checked = !!S.secret;
  $("#opt-flash").value = String(S.flashMs);

  const box = $("#studs"); box.innerHTML = "";
  S.students.forEach(st => {
    const row = document.createElement("div"); row.className = "studrow";
    const inp = document.createElement("input");
    inp.type = "text"; inp.value = st.name; inp.id = "name-" + st.id; inp.maxLength = 14;
    inp.style.color = COLORS[st.color] || COLORS.bleu;
    inp.oninput = () => { st.name = inp.value || "Élève"; save(); renderChips(); };
    const sws = document.createElement("div"); sws.className = "swatches";
    Object.keys(COLORS).forEach(k => {
      const s = document.createElement("button");
      s.className = "sw" + (st.color === k ? " on" : "");
      s.style.setProperty("--c", COLORS[k]); s.title = k;
      s.onclick = () => { st.color = k; save(); renderPanel(); renderChips(); };
      sws.appendChild(s);
    });
    row.appendChild(inp); row.appendChild(sws);
    if(S.students.length > 1){
      const k = document.createElement("button");
      k.className = "kill"; k.textContent = "×"; k.title = "retirer";
      k.onclick = () => { S.students = S.students.filter(x => x !== st); save(); renderPanel(); renderChips(); };
      row.appendChild(k);
    }
    box.appendChild(row);
  });
}

$("#auto-level").onchange = e => { S.autoLevel = e.target.checked; save(); };
$("#opt-voice").onchange = e => { S.voice = e.target.checked; save(); if(S.voice) speak("Bonjour !"); };
$("#opt-sound").onchange = e => { S.sound = e.target.checked; save(); if(S.sound) sfxPop(2); };
$("#opt-secret").onchange = e => { S.secret = e.target.checked; save(); };
$("#opt-flash").onchange = e => { S.flashMs = +e.target.value; save(); };

  const used = S.students.map(s => s.color);

  S.students.push({id:"s" + Date.now().toString(36), name:"Élève", color: free[0] || "bleu", stars:0});

};

});

/* ---------------- clavier ---------------- */
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if(e.target && /^(INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(e.target.tagName)) return;
  const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(k === "escape"){ openPanel(false); return; }
  if(!$("#panel").hidden) return;
  if(k === " " || k === "spacebar"){
    e.preventDefault();
    const b = $("#btn-main"); if(!b.hidden) b.click();
    return;
  }
  if(phase === "board" && /^[1-9]$/.test(k)){ e.preventDefault(); answer(+k); return; }
  if(phase === "ask" && "abcdef".indexOf(k) >= 0){
    const st = S.students["abcdef".indexOf(k)];
    if(st) goBoard(st);
    return;
  }
  if(k === "r" && R && phase !== "deco" && phase !== "decowin"){ recount(() => askPhase()); }
});

  }catch(e){
    $("#store-note").textContent = "Les étoiles sont gardées sur cet appareil et ce navigateur.";
  }
